messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly tactical note — short + actionable. TL;DR: growth momentum healthy, reliability needs focus, launching EU Dedicated went well, one Friday blip we fixed, and a small policy tweak on logs. Please skim and flag anything urgent.

Ava (CEO): Metrics highlights: p50 gen latency 48ms, p95 210ms (across hosted fleet). Cost: unit token cost down ~12% month-over-month after Optimize defaults rolled out. New signups converting at 4.6% (steady).

Ava (CEO): Ops/Incidents: Friday ~18m partial degradation for some Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 during a scaling event. Root cause: race in autoscaler + fallback path for model variants leading to overloaded nodes. No user data exposure. Postmortem in #incidents and doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/fy25/incident-176934.

Ava (CEO): Deployed mitigations: hotfix to autoscaler (commit `b3f9c1e`), tightened rollout canary window, more aggressive failover to smaller-quantized variants. Noah + Sam to do a full load replay and validate KV cache behavior this week.

Ava (CEO): Product/Revenue: Dedicated EU launch hit first-week target (20% of committed capacity filled). Private beta onboarding: 3 customers (banking, health, gov) scheduled next week — legal + security, heads-up to the teams.

Ava (CEO): Policy update (small): default logs & eval retention shortened to 90 days for hosted free/standard tiers to reduce storage costs and limit surface area. Enterprise / Dedicated customers can opt for longer retention via contract. New retention workflow + KMS key rotation notes are on Confluence. This is effective immediately — security/compliance approved. @Priya please coordinate billing language updates.

Ava (CEO): Priorities for the week: 1) Close autoscaler reliability fixes and run the SLO injection tests; 2) Finish Private beta onboarding checklist (security + E2E infra); 3) Sales + ENG tact: convert dedicated trials to 3-month commits; 4) Hire: 2 infra SWE, 1 SRE, 1 solutions engineer.

Sam (VP Eng): Thanks — infra is on it. Autoscaler fix rolled to canary at 09:12 today. Running distributed replay job `replay-2026-03-22` overnight, will share perf diffs tomorrow.

Noah (SRE Lead): Incident brief: root cause was a lock contention leading to delayed node registration during scale-up. Mitigations: (a) commit `b3f9c1e` reduces lock hold time, (b) fallback path rate limiter added, (c) canary expanded to 5% traffic. Full postmortem draft by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Patch `b3f9c1e` rolled to canary at 2026-03-23T09:12:07Z by Sam (VP Eng). Canary: 5% traffic, no regressions so far.

Maya (Head Product): Appreciate the clear notes. Small ask: product wants telemetry on model-variant fallbacks per route (to prioritize which routes need quantized variants). Can eng add a lightweight counter metric this week?

Sam (VP Eng): Yep — adding counter `fallback.variant.count` to the routing layer, tag by route & model. ETA - end of week.

Priya (Finance): Noted on retention change. I'll update pricing page and send a short FAQ for CS to use. Also running updated cost projection with the 12% unit cost reduction — will share by Wednesday.

Liam: Thanks for the update Ava and team. :thumbsup:

Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone — small ask: leads, please add a 1-line status update in the exec doc by EOD Thursday (reliability, growth, hires). We'll review in Friday 10:30 sync.

Noah (SRE Lead): Will do.

Maya (Head Product): Adding roadmap notes now.
